title: The map, enforced
sub: Film 5 of 7 of From helper to colleague: the map says what an agent may do, and every tool holds it to that. All year, Jun's helper drafted Planning's changes on his own sign-in, so every change said Jun, and it could do whatever he could. The planning agent has its own name in every tool, a service principal in Databricks, an App in GitHub and the same sign-in in dbt, with no secret it can see or leak. A script writes its rights into each tool from its place on the map, a check finds a right the map doesn't hold, and it works in a place of its own, under its own name in every log, with a switch that stops it alone.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's marble and oak. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is tools and structure (the map, the tools, the group and its grants, the locks), violet the model and what an agent does (its band, its own lines in a log), orange data coming back, green a check that passes, and amber something wrong (the changes nobody could place, a right the map doesn't hold, a call refused). The agents look alike: each wears its badge, with its name on it.
